title: Self-Organizing Digital Infrastructure — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Reorganizes indexes, services, and workloads as system demands and available resources change. A proposed infrastructure that reorganizes itself: as demand shifts and resources change, it rebuilds indexes, migrates services, rebalances workloads, and retires what is no longer needed — continuously optimizing the layout of the digital estate within policy bounds.
capabilities: Monitor demand and resource changes continuously
Rebuild and relocate indexes for hot data
Migrate services toward demand
Rebalance workloads across resources
Retire unused services within policy bounds
